target_population.description: Records in Atlas v1.0-RC1 with license='unknown' — these have no assigned difficulty level.
target_population.note: These ~1.54M records represent approximately 15.6% of the total dataset. They were excluded from difficulty assignment during the v0.1-v0.3 release chain because their source license was marked unknown.

dry_run_results.description: Results from dry-run sample classification on 16 synthetic representative records spanning all 4 unknown source types and all 9 categories.

predicted_distribution.methodology: Extrapolated from per-source dry-run sample rates scaled to full source populations. Confidence intervals reflect uncertainty from small sample.

other_unknown.note: Insufficient sample for per-source projection. Allocated at aggregate rate.

confidence_analysis.summary: Mean confidence 0.70 indicates reasonable signal quality. Low-confidence samples are concentrated in very short records (< 30 tokens) where the classifier lacks sufficient text for reliable scoring.
confidence_analysis.recommendation: Records with confidence < 0.5 should be flagged for manual review or rule-based override based on source and category metadata.

limitations.sample_size: The dry-run sample (n=16) is too small for reliable per-source projections. Full production classification is required.
limitations.ceiling_effect: No L4 or L5 samples were included in synthetic test data. Real arXiv CS papers and advanced OpenWebMath derivations are expected to produce L3-L5 classifications.
limitations.source_representation: The synthetic sample may not capture the full distribution of each source. Tulu-3 includes instruction-tuning data spanning all difficulty levels.
limitations.vocabulary_bias: Technical vocabulary detection is English-centric and may undercount non-English technical terms.
limitations.deterministic_limitation: Rule-based classification cannot match human judgment quality. Results should be validated against human review on a stratified sample.

next_steps: Run full production classification across all 1,543,548 unknown records
Validate against human review on a stratified sample (100 records per source)
Calibrate classifier thresholds based on human agreement analysis
Integrate difficulty metadata into training view generation pipeline
Establish ongoing monitoring for distribution drift as new sources are added
